title: Malicious code in gmo-payment-carrier (RubyGems)
description: The gmo-payment-carrier RubyGem contains malicious code that steals credentials. During installation and runtime, it collects host identity information, AWS IAM role credentials via IMDSv2, ECS metadata, and environment variables containing database secrets. This data is exfiltrated to a hardcoded external URL unrelated to the legitimate publisher.
